scope: Preserved external review and selected evidence only; not a new review, fix, execution GO, or complete runnable source checkout. Archive scripts were read and copied, not executed during this intake.
external_verdict: Integer parsing correction accepted; Q2/Q3 integrity closure HOLD; ULPRI-01 and ULPRI-02 P2 open

report_normalization.transformation: byte replace CRLF with LF only; no text/content edits

selection.omitted_rule: All archive member paths not in selected[].archive_member. The complete name/hash inventory is archive/MANIFEST.sha256; MANIFEST.sha256 itself is the original archive self-exclusion. Omitted content remains in the unchanged original ZIP.
selection.reasons: Keep all six focused current-pin boundary inputs/results, original reproduction scripts, compact baseline result, named report evidence summaries and raw diagnosis/mutation logs. Omit repo/baseline source copies, duplicated baseline fixtures, other exploratory case directories, copied mutation source files, large Git API trees/commit payloads, collection-only scripts, and redundant suite logs; these remain in the original ZIP.
selection.byte_preservation: All selected original files except the report remain byte-identical. A directory-local .gitattributes marks original evidence, scripts and archive/source-pin files -text; shared root attributes are unchanged.
